items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Roy was at the Grand Terrace with Fletcher Henderson, he and Chu Berry. So Roy formed this band that I was in Roy's band.

ctx.x: But any way, I -- after Art left, Roy left Fletchers.
Roy was at the Grand Terrace with Fletcher Henderson, he and Chu Berry. So Roy formed this band that I was in Roy's band.

Gosh, I can't tell you, I stayed there for three years with Roy, I imagine. And that was a tremendous band. No, we had about six -- let's see, four rhythm, and three horns. Roy Eldridge, Dave Young playing tenor, and Scoops Carey playing alto saxophone. Tremendous alto saxophone player.
